get.summary: Lists the script handlers a form registers, in formxml order.
get.description: Read from the environment's latest completed scan. formId is the systemform id. A form that scan did not capture returns 404. formName and table are the form's name and the logical name of its table on that scan, present whatever the coverage. A captured form with no handlers returns coverage modeled and an empty handlers list. When Pathix cannot say what the form registers, coverage is notModeled, notModeledReason says why and handlers is null, which is never the same answer as an empty list: handlersNotRecorded means the scan holds no handler rows for any form (a scan taken before handlers were captured, or an environment with none), and formNotParsed means the form's formxml could not be read. Each handler carries its event, what the event belongs to (scope Form, Tab or Control, and the tab name or control id in scopeName), the column an onchange is attached to, the function, the library the form names, and the script component the library resolved to (null when it resolved to none). A null flag means the formxml did not say. isPlatformLoaded handlers are tagged, never hidden. ordered is true when every handler carries its position in the formxml and the list is in that order. On a scan that predates the position, ordered is false and the list is a stable sort by scope, scope name, event, library and function, which must not be read as a sequence; the next scan restores the order.
